arms.A: v1: walk order, first N characters, no line numbers

metrics.recall: share of gold lines that appear complete in the context
metrics.mrr: 1/rank of the first context block that overlaps a gold span (0 if none); a block is a file for arm A and a chunk for B, C and D
metrics.any_gold_in_context: share of questions with at least one gold line shown
metrics.ci95: percentile bootstrap over questions, 10,000 resamples, seed 0
